title: Implement and register goal tools
objective: Implement GetGoal, CreateGoal, and UpdateGoal tools and register them with the runtime.
context: These tools let the model inspect and mark the goal, but they must not bypass slash-command or permission semantics.
Registration touches shared registry setup, so this should run after other registry-heavy work is quiet.

source_evidence.note: Existing task/todo tools are registered in a central setup path.

include: Share GoalRuntime with slash command where practical.
Keep nil runtime behavior explicit and safe.

implementation_steps: Implement schemas and execution with fake-friendly runtime.
Run tools and registry focused tests.
deliverables: Model-facing goal tools are available through registry setup.
acceptance_criteria: Registry can find the goal tools.
Tool metadata marks GetGoal read-only and CreateGoal/UpdateGoal mutating.
risks: registry_setup.go is a shared high-conflict file.
dispatch_prompt: Implement and register GetGoal, CreateGoal, and UpdateGoal tools to satisfy tools/goal_tools_test.go. Keep runtime injection safe and metadata accurate.
notes_for_assignee: If the shared tool contract layer is mid-change, coordinate upward before editing registry_setup.go.
